public_rationale: Contemporaneous reporting supports a real retreat: several major employers were discouraging tokenmaxxing and reassessing token-use targets. That is meaningful evidence for Marcus's observation. It does not clearly establish the stronger claim that the trend had already ended broadly by June 10. The earlier anticipation also could not be verified from a readable original record. Calling the claim contradicted would overstate the evidence against it; calling it supported would treat documented retrenchment as sufficient proof of its asserted endpoint.
limitations: The distinction between an emerging retreat and a trend having died is not defined by the speaker.
Available reports cover prominent examples rather than a measured cross-section of adopters.
The June 10 report has no verified publication time relative to the post.

statement.excerpt: First of all, domino one: tokenmaxxing has indeed clearly died, just as Eisman and I had anticipated a few weeks ago.
statement.document_title: Breaking news, and how the end might begin

from_speaker: just as Eisman and I had anticipated
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that the trend of maximizing token consumption as an end in itself had broadly reversed by June 10. It does not require every heavy user to stop using AI.

The surrounding discussion connects this reversal to providers restricting bundled usage and customers resisting the resulting costs. Neither growing total token consumption nor growing revenue would alone contradict the claim.

For the ongoing state, use June 1–10, the latest observable calendar month to date. Earlier developments may supply context; developments after June 10 cannot establish that the reversal had already happened.
The assertion of prior anticipation also requires a dated earlier record of Marcus and Eisman discussing the relevant reversal.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous evidence establishes a broad reversal of tokenmaxxing across major adopters by June 10, with a dated earlier record showing Marcus and Eisman anticipated that development.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous evidence establishes that maximizing token use remained a broadly expanding practice through June 10, rather than undergoing the claimed reversal; or a reliable earlier record materially conflicts with the claimed anticipation. Isolated continuing users would not suffice.
